correctness.rationale: The normalized forward child shift is isometric levelwise and nilpotent. Its Wold-type wandering subspaces have dimensions (b-1)b^{d-1}; hence (I-S)^{-1} splits into exact lower-triangular ones blocks of lengths L with claimed multiplicities. Diagonalizing the discrete difference D_L*D_L gives exact sine-law singulars. Geometrically decaying chain fractions give the limiting dense atomic measure and all fixed moments, the largest length L*(t) gives rate -(π/2)log b, and direct row-square sums prove the exact S2 identity. The original proof covers h=0 and fixed b≥2; independent finite tree SVD tests agree but do not prove weak convergence.
